title: Flashblinder

sources.title: Burned Out Optics
markers: | effects = * Affected entity's optical lens has been distorted, causing its vision become impaired. Entity recieves 1d6 penalty to [[Attack Rolls]].

summary: Throw to Blind creatures and disable Steel Watchers.

fields.Throw: Action. Throw one bomb up to 60 ft. Affects a 20 ft radius. DC 16 Constitution against Blinded for 10 turns.
fields.Steel Watchers: Malfunctioning Stuns them for 2 turns, or 1 turn in Honour Mode, then Burned Out Optics applies a 1d6 attack roll penalty. The bomb also disables the Titan’s Defensive Protocol: Bulwark.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Behir Scales with any Ashes.
fields.Base value: 160 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Blinded: Your attack rolls have disadvantage and incoming attacks have advantage. Attack and sight-dependent spell range is limited to 10 ft. You cannot make Opportunity Attacks. Throw retains its normal range.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
